newsitem.title: ITALY: Minimum rate 8.58 pct at Italy lira repo.
newsitem.headline: Minimum rate 8.58 pct at Italy lira repo.

text.p: The minimum rate at today's 14.0 trillion lire seven-day Bank of Italy repurchase tender was 8.58 percent, compared with 8.85 percent previously, the Bank said.
The average rate was 8.70 percent against 8.86 percent at the last repurchase pact for 9.0 trillion lire and 22 days on August 21.
The pact takes effect today and the securities are for resale on September 2. The Bank said it received 43 bids of which 38 were met in full and one in part.
